Though the matter is listed for hearing on interlocutory application, with the consent of parties,
matter is taken up for final disposal.

2. Heard Sri.Chandreshekhar M. Hosamani, learned counsel for the appellant and Sri.M.Y.Katagi,
learned counsel for respondent No.3.
3.

The present appeal is filed by the claimant seeking enhancement of the compensation due to road traffic accident that occurred on 23.05.2008 at about 4.00 a.m. at Ananthasayanagudi on account of rash and negligent driving of the driver of the Tata Sumo vehicle bearing No.KA-19/M-9738 by challenging the validity of the judgment and award passed MVC No.314/2009 dated 28.12.2010 on the file of Additional Motor Vehicles Claim Tribunal, Hospet.

entities.text: Additional Motor Vehicles Claim Tribunal, Hospet
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Sri.Chandreshekhar M. Hosamani, learned counsel submits that the income has not been properly computed by the Tribunal for the accidental injuries sustained in the year 2008 and only Rs.3000/- has been taken into account as against Rs.4,250/- as such there is a scope for enhanced compensation.

5. He also contended that on the head of loss of income during laid-up period is not properly assessed and therefore, on that score also, there is a scope for enhancement so also on the attendant charges.

2

6. Per contra, Sri.M.Y.Katagi, learned counsel for Insurance Company supported the impugned judgment by contending that Tribunal has granted sufficient adjudged compensation by applying the principles of the year, prevailed in the year 2009.
7. In view of the rival contentions of the parties, this Court perused the material on record meticulously.

On such perusal of the material on record, it is established that claimant has sustained accidental injuries on account of rash and negligent driving of the driver of the Tata Sumo vehicle bearing No.KA-19/M- 9738.
The claimant has suffered fracture injury.
9. Tribunal has taken into consideration the said aspect of the matter and allowed the claim petition in a sum of Rs.1,10,840/-.
10. While so allowing the claim petition, income that is computed by Tribunal is incorrect.
So also on the other heads, claimant is entitled for reasonable enhancement.

11. Taking note of these aspects of the matter, instead of enhancing on each and every head, if a sum of Rs.25,000/- is enhanced over and above Rs.1,10,840/- ends of justice would be met.
12.

Accordingly, following:
NC: 2024:KHC-D:3652 ORDER (i) Appeal is allowed as against sum of Rs.1,10,840/- claimant is entitled to Rs.1,35,840/- with interest at 6% p.a. from the date of petition till realisation.
(ii) Amount in deposit is ordered to be transmitted to the Tribunal.
Less the period of 2161 days.
(iii) No order as to costs.

Sd/-
